name: Samtex Fashions Limited
about: Samtex Fashions Limited manufactures and sells ready-made garments in India. The company offers jackets, ladies and men trousers, and shorts and skirts. It is also involved in trading of food grains. The company exports its products to stores in the United States and Europe. Samtex Fashions Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
